E0_Baseline.name: E0: Phase 1.6 Baseline
E0_Baseline.hypothesis: Baseline sentence-local extraction without document-context resolution

E1_Bounded_Candidate_Gen.name: E1: Bounded Candidate Generation Only
E1_Bounded_Candidate_Gen.hypothesis: Generate cross-sentence candidates across sentence window dist<=1 without committing

E2_Adjacent_Connectives.name: E2: Adjacent-Sentence Discourse Connectives
E2_Adjacent_Connectives.hypothesis: Resolve explicit discourse connectives ('Consequently', 'As a result', 'Therefore') across adjacent sentences

E3_Demonstrative_Anaphora.name: E3: Demonstrative Causal Anaphora Resolution
E3_Demonstrative_Anaphora.hypothesis: Resolve demonstrative pronouns ('This result', 'These findings') to antecedent cause/effect

E4_Sentence_Stitching.name: E4: Sentence Boundary Abbreviation Stitching
E4_Sentence_Stitching.hypothesis: Stitch sentences fragmented by taxonomic genus and citation abbreviations ('P. gingivalis', 'et al.')

E5_Full_Document_Context.name: E5: Full Calibrated Document-Context Resolver
E5_Full_Document_Context.hypothesis: Stitching + Demonstrative Anaphora + Discourse Connectives + Invariant FP Controls
